conclusion: No newly identified source blocker in the exact fresh nonperiodic AppRole fixture's receipt fields or same-token expiry comparison. This is not actual renewal qualification.

semantics.empty_json_renew: Absent increment becomes zero, selecting the current role/mount default TTL rather than adding time to the old expiry.
semantics.coarse_approle_expiry: AppRole issuance uses token_api_precision=None and renewal stores u64 expires_at; lookup exposes expire_time_unix and integer ttl directly.
semantics.identity: HTTP layer echoes the presented token; backend accessor and retained creation_time must also agree. Echo alone is not independent identity authentication.
semantics.maximum: Nonperiodic expiry is limited by original issue time plus effective current maximum and any explicit cap captured at issue. Renewable=true does not assert unused maximum-TTL headroom.
semantics.observable_extension: Only post.expire_time_unix > pre.expire_time_unix proves an increased stored expiry for this exact coarse AppRole scope; TTL need not increase.
semantics.same_second_or_cap: A successful 200 with unchanged expiry can be correct and yields an evidence gap, not a renewal backend error.
semantics.no_guarantee: Moving pre lookup before existing KV/ACL work increases opportunity for a clock boundary but guarantees neither a full integer second nor enough remaining lease time.
semantics.revoke: Typed pre/post snapshots followed by original revoke-self 204 and denied GET 403 happen before the returned delta classification; final two-phase extension check occurs after inverses and original validations.
semantics.unknown: Any dispatched HTTP/validation/deadline/closure failure retains the original conservative unknown behavior; the known same-expiry evidence-gap conclusion applies only when every relevant response and owned closure is known.

blind_spots.detail: The same-second fake uses pre ttl170/expiry1180 and post ttl175/expiry1180, implying coarse now1010->1005 rather than a same-second observation. It proves delta classification only.
blind_spots.minimal_future_change: Use explicit consistent issuance/pre/renew/post integer timestamps to derive each fake TTL and expiry; preserve original frozen test evidence.

blind_spots.detail: Wrong lookup accessor and wrong renewed token are covered; correct renewed token with wrong renewed accessor is not an independent fake case, although candidate line833 rejects it.
blind_spots.minimal_future_change: One renewal response override changing only accessor; require refusal and no next request.

blind_spots.detail: No actual same-role maximum-saturation fake derives a shortened renewal lease with unchanged absolute expiry. Also no original HTTP failed-max/expiry status is simulated by this FakeClient.
blind_spots.minimal_future_change: One consistent capped-live case returning 200 with positive reduced lease TTL and unchanged expiry; preserve no-extension classification. Product auth tests already contain separate max/error cases, and have not been rerun here.
